flags.message: CourtListener MCP search returned zero results for all six queries, including a liveness check on a known SCOTUS docket number (25-1119). Treated the MCP surface as unavailable and predicted from the provisioned inputs and the committed statpack; no REST fallback attempted.

Decisive pre-snapshot public signal: both briefs in opposition report that the Court denied certiorari in Curtis v. Inslee (No. 25-1119), the published Ninth Circuit decision this unpublished disposition rests on, on June 1, 2026, along with Sweeney (No. 25-1055) and Horsley (No. 25-1203), and denied Carvalho (No. 25-765) on May 18, 2026. Legitimate forward signal, not this case's own outcome; it drove the downward adjustment from the band anchor.
